51327741.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to GAK (unknown origin) by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: ITC experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. GAK (10 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and compound 11 (1 mM) was loaded into the syringe. The buffer was 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.01% Tween-20, pH 7.4. The syringe was programmed to inject 20 μL of compound 11 into the sample cell in 20 injections of 1 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The reference cell contained buffer only. Data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab) with a one-site binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. (A) Binding affinity of 11 for NAK family kinases. aTemperature shift of GAK denaturation (n = 4); bTR-FRET-based ligand binding displacement assay (n = 1). (B) DSF curve of GAK and 11. (C) ITC of GAK and 11. (D) KINOMEScan KD results, and (E) KD values for top 5 highest affinity kinases.
